lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Thank you for calling customer support, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Hi. I returned a pair of headphones three weeks ago and I still have not received my refund. This is really frustrating.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: I am sorry to hear that, I understand how frustrating it is to wait that long. Can I have your order number please?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: It is order four five seven two. I have called twice already and nobody fixed it. I just want my money back.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Thank you. I can see the return arrived at our warehouse, but the refund was never released. I apologize for that.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: I have now issued the refund of eighty nine dollars to your card. You will see it within three to five business days.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Oh, that is great news. Thank you, that is a real relief.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: You are welcome. I will also email you the refund confirmation. Is there anything else I can help you with?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: No, that is everything. Thanks a lot for sorting this out so quickly.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: My pleasure. Have a wonderful day.
